local reserved = {}
for word in ("not mod count sum min max retract dump why forget listing strata stats check predicates undo halt"):gmatch(
    "%S+"
) do
    reserved[word] = true
end
local function fail(format, ...)
    error({reason = string.format(format, ...)}, 0)
end
local function contains(items, value)
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        if item == value then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function keys(set)
    local result = {}
    for key in pairs(set) do
        result[#result + 1] = key
    end
    table.sort(result)
    return result
end
local function copy(map)
    local result = {}
    for key, value in pairs(map) do
        result[key] = value
    end
    return result
end
local function lower(c)
    return c ~= "" and c >= "a" and c <= "z"
end
local function upper(c)
    return c ~= "" and c >= "A" and c <= "Z"
end
local function digit(c)
    return c ~= "" and c >= "0" and c <= "9"
end
local function word_character(c)
    return lower(c) or upper(c) or digit(c) or c == "_"
end
local function lexical(line)
    local result, i = {}, 1
    while i <= #line do
        local c, start = line:sub(i, i), i
        if c == " " then
            i = i + 1
        elseif c == "%" then
            break
        elseif c == '"' then
            local closing = line:find('"', i + 1, true)
            if not closing then
                fail("unterminated string")
            end
            result[#result + 1] = {kind = "string", text = line:sub(i, closing)}
            i = closing + 1
        elseif contains({":-", "?-", "!=", "<=", ">="}, line:sub(i, i + 1)) then
            local text = line:sub(i, i + 1)
            result[#result + 1] = {kind = text, text = text}
            i = i + 2
        elseif ("(),.:=<>+-*/"):find(c, 1, true) then
            result[#result + 1] = {kind = c, text = c}
            i = i + 1
        else
            if not word_character(c) then
                fail("bad character '%s'", c)
            end
            repeat
                i = i + 1
            until not word_character(line:sub(i, i))
            local text = line:sub(start, i - 1)
            local item = {text = text}
            if lower(c) then
                item.kind = reserved[text] and text or "name"
            elseif upper(c) then
                item.kind = "variable"
            elseif text == "_" then
                item.kind = "anonymous"
            else
                if not text:match("^%d+$") then
                    fail("bad token '%s'", text)
                end
                item.kind, item.number = "integer", tonumber(text)
                if item.number > 1000000000 then
                    fail("integer out of range '%s'", text)
                end
            end
            result[#result + 1] = item
        end
    end
    return result
end
local Parser = {}
Parser.__index = Parser
function Parser:peek()
    return self.tokens[self.position] and self.tokens[self.position].kind or "end"
end
function Parser:invalid()
    if self:peek() == "end" then
        fail("syntax error at end of line")
    end
    fail("syntax error at '%s'", self.tokens[self.position].text)
end
function Parser:take(kind)
    if self:peek() ~= kind then
        self:invalid()
    end
    local item = self.tokens[self.position]
    self.position = self.position + 1
    return item
end
function Parser:term()
    local kind = self:peek()
    if kind == "name" then
        return {kind = "constant", value = self:take(kind).text}
    elseif kind == "string" then
        return {kind = "constant", value = self:take(kind).text:sub(2, -2)}
    elseif kind == "integer" then
        return {kind = "constant", value = self:take(kind).number}
    elseif kind == "-" then
        self:take("-")
        return {kind = "constant", value = -self:take("integer").number}
    elseif kind == "variable" then
        return {kind = kind, name = self:take(kind).text}
    elseif kind == "anonymous" then
        self:take(kind)
        return {kind = kind}
    end
    self:invalid()
end
function Parser:atom()
    local result = {name = self:take("name").text, terms = {}}
    if self:peek() == "(" then
        self:take("(")
        result.terms[1] = self:term()
        while self:peek() == "," do
            self:take(",")
            result.terms[#result.terms + 1] = self:term()
        end
        self:take(")")
    end
    return result
end
function Parser:factor()
    if self:peek() == "(" then
        self:take("(")
        local inside = self:expression()
        self:take(")")
        return {kind = "group", left = inside}
    end
    return {kind = "term", term = self:term()}
end
function Parser:product()
    local result = self:factor()
    while contains({"*", "/", "mod"}, self:peek()) do
        local operator = self:take(self:peek()).kind
        result = {kind = "operation", operator = operator, left = result, right = self:factor()}
    end
    return result
end
function Parser:expression()
    local result = self:product()
    while self:peek() == "+" or self:peek() == "-" do
        local operator = self:take(self:peek()).kind
        result = {kind = "operation", operator = operator, left = result, right = self:product()}
    end
    return result
end
function Parser:literal()
    if self:peek() == "not" then
        self:take("not")
        return {kind = "negative", atom = self:atom()}
    end
    if self:peek() == "name" then
        local next_kind =
            self.tokens[self.position + 1] and self.tokens[self.position + 1].kind or "end"
        if not contains({"=", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=", "+", "-", "*", "/", "mod"}, next_kind) then
            return {kind = "positive", atom = self:atom()}
        end
    end
    local left = self:expression()
    if not contains({"=", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">="}, self:peek()) then
        self:invalid()
    end
    local operator = self:take(self:peek()).kind
    return {kind = "comparison", operator = operator, left = left, right = self:expression()}
end
function Parser:body()
    local result = {self:literal()}
    while self:peek() == "," do
        self:take(",")
        result[#result + 1] = self:literal()
    end
    return result
end
function Parser:statement()
    local kind = self:peek()
    local result = {body = {}}
    if kind == "name" then
        result.head, result.kind = self:atom(), "fact"
        if self:peek() == ":-" then
            self:take(":-")
            result.kind, result.body = "rule", self:body()
        end
    elseif kind == ":-" then
        self:take(kind)
        result.kind, result.body = "constraint", self:body()
    elseif kind == "?-" then
        self:take(kind)
        result.kind = "query"
        if contains({"count", "sum", "min", "max"}, self:peek()) then
            result.aggregate = self:take(self:peek()).kind
            if result.aggregate ~= "count" then
                result.variable = self:take("variable").text
                self:take(":")
            end
        end
        result.body = self:body()
    elseif kind == "retract" or kind == "why" then
        self:take(kind)
        result.kind, result.head = kind, self:atom()
    elseif kind == "dump" then
        self:take(kind)
        result.kind, result.name = kind, self:take("name").text
    elseif kind == "forget" then
        self:take(kind)
        result.kind, result.number = kind, self:take("integer").number
    elseif kind == "listing" then
        self:take(kind)
        result.kind = kind
        if self:peek() == "name" then
            result.name = self:take("name").text
        end
    elseif contains({"strata", "stats", "check", "predicates", "undo", "halt"}, kind) then
        self:take(kind)
        result.kind = kind
    else
        self:invalid()
    end
    self:take(".")
    if self:peek() ~= "end" then
        self:invalid()
    end
    return result
end
local function compare_value(a, b)
    if type(a) ~= type(b) then
        return type(a) == "number" and -1 or 1
    end
    return a < b and -1 or a > b and 1 or 0
end
local function compare_tuple(a, b)
    for i = 1, #a do
        local order = compare_value(a[i], b[i])
        if order ~= 0 then
            return order
        end
    end
    return 0
end
local function notation(value)
    if type(value) == "number" then
        return tostring(value)
    end
    if value:match("^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$") and not reserved[value] then
        return value
    end
    return '"' .. value .. '"'
end
local function term_text(term, assignment)
    if term.kind == "constant" then
        return notation(term.value)
    end
    if term.kind == "anonymous" then
        return "_"
    end
    return assignment and notation(assignment[term.name]) or term.name
end
local function atom_text(atom, assignment)
    if #atom.terms == 0 then
        return atom.name
    end
    local parts = {}
    for _, term in ipairs(atom.terms) do
        parts[#parts + 1] = term_text(term, assignment)
    end
    return atom.name .. "(" .. table.concat(parts, ", ") .. ")"
end
local function expression_text(expression, assignment)
    if expression.kind == "term" then
        return term_text(expression.term, assignment)
    end
    if expression.kind == "group" then
        return "(" .. expression_text(expression.left, assignment) .. ")"
    end
    return expression_text(expression.left, assignment) ..
        " " .. expression.operator .. " " .. expression_text(expression.right, assignment)
end
local function literal_text(literal, assignment)
    if literal.kind == "comparison" then
        return expression_text(literal.left, assignment) ..
            " " .. literal.operator .. " " .. expression_text(literal.right, assignment)
    end
    return (literal.kind == "negative" and "not " or "") .. atom_text(literal.atom, assignment)
end
local function rule_text(statement)
    local parts = {}
    for _, literal in ipairs(statement.body) do
        parts[#parts + 1] = literal_text(literal)
    end
    return (statement.head and atom_text(statement.head) .. " :- " or ":- ") ..
        table.concat(parts, ", ") .. "."
end
local function expression_terms(expression, result)
    if expression.kind == "term" then
        result[#result + 1] = expression.term
    else
        expression_terms(expression.left, result)
        if expression.kind == "operation" then
            expression_terms(expression.right, result)
        end
    end
end
local function literal_terms(literal)
    if literal.kind ~= "comparison" then
        return literal.atom.terms
    end
    local result = {}
    expression_terms(literal.left, result)
    expression_terms(literal.right, result)
    return result
end
local function all_terms(statement)
    local result = {}
    if statement.head then
        for _, term in ipairs(statement.head.terms) do
            result[#result + 1] = term
        end
    end
    for _, literal in ipairs(statement.body) do
        for _, term in ipairs(literal_terms(literal)) do
            result[#result + 1] = term
        end
    end
    return result
end
local function variables(terms)
    local result, seen = {}, {}
    for _, term in ipairs(terms) do
        if term.kind == "variable" and not seen[term.name] then
            seen[term.name] = true
            result[#result + 1] = term.name
        end
    end
    return result
end
local function tuple_key(tuple)
    local result = {}
    for _, value in ipairs(tuple) do
        result[#result + 1] =
            type(value) == "number" and "i" .. value .. ";" or "s" .. #value .. ":" .. value
    end
    return table.concat(result)
end
local function ordered_tuples(set)
    local result = {}
    for _, tuple in pairs(set) do
        result[#result + 1] = tuple
    end
    table.sort(
        result,
        function(a, b)
            return compare_tuple(a.values, b.values) < 0
        end
    )
    return result
end
local function atoms(statement)
    local result = {}
    if statement.head then
        result[1] = statement.head
    end
    for _, literal in ipairs(statement.body) do
        if literal.kind ~= "comparison" then
            result[#result + 1] = literal.atom
        end
    end
    return result
end
local Database = {}
Database.__index = Database
function Database.new()
    return setmetatable({predicates = {}, rules = {}, history = {}, next_number = 1}, Database)
end
function Database:save(line)
    local predicates, rules = {}, {}
    for name, predicate in pairs(self.predicates) do
        predicates[name] = {arity = predicate.arity, facts = copy(predicate.facts)}
    end
    for i, rule in ipairs(self.rules) do
        rules[i] = rule
    end
    self.history[#self.history + 1] = {predicates = predicates, rules = rules, line = line}
end
function Database:check_predicates(statement, clause)
    local arities = {}
    for name, predicate in pairs(self.predicates) do
        arities[name] = predicate.arity
    end
    for _, atom in ipairs(atoms(statement)) do
        local expected = arities[atom.name]
        if expected == nil and not clause then
            fail("unknown predicate %s", atom.name)
        end
        if expected ~= nil and expected ~= #atom.terms then
            fail("arity mismatch for %s: expected %d, got %d", atom.name, expected, #atom.terms)
        end
        arities[atom.name] = #atom.terms
    end
    return arities
end
local function safety(statement)
    if statement.head then
        for _, term in ipairs(statement.head.terms) do
            if term.kind == "anonymous" then
                fail("anonymous variable in head")
            end
        end
    end
    local bound = {}
    for _, literal in ipairs(statement.body) do
        if literal.kind == "comparison" then
            for _, term in ipairs(literal_terms(literal)) do
                if term.kind == "anonymous" then
                    fail("anonymous variable in comparison")
                end
            end
        end
        if literal.kind == "positive" then
            for _, name in ipairs(variables(literal.atom.terms)) do
                bound[name] = true
            end
        end
    end
    local checked = {}
    if statement.head then
        for _, term in ipairs(statement.head.terms) do
            checked[#checked + 1] = term
        end
    end
    if statement.aggregate and statement.aggregate ~= "count" then
        checked[#checked + 1] = {kind = "variable", name = statement.variable}
    end
    for _, literal in ipairs(statement.body) do
        if literal.kind ~= "positive" then
            for _, term in ipairs(literal_terms(literal)) do
                checked[#checked + 1] = term
            end
        end
    end
    for _, term in ipairs(checked) do
        if term.kind == "variable" and not bound[term.name] then
            fail("unsafe variable %s", term.name)
        end
    end
end
local function strata(arities, rules)
    local names = keys(arities)
    local reach, levels, recursive = {}, {}, {}
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        reach[name] = {}
        levels[name] = 0
    end
    for _, rule in ipairs(rules) do
        if rule.statement.head then
            for _, literal in ipairs(rule.statement.body) do
                if literal.kind ~= "comparison" then
                    reach[rule.statement.head.name][literal.atom.name] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, middle in ipairs(names) do
        for _, a in ipairs(names) do
            for _, b in ipairs(names) do
                if reach[a][middle] and reach[middle][b] then
                    reach[a][b] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        recursive[name] = reach[name][name] or false
    end
    for _, rule in ipairs(rules) do
        if rule.statement.head then
            for _, literal in ipairs(rule.statement.body) do
                if
                    literal.kind == "negative" and
                        (literal.atom.name == rule.statement.head.name or
                            reach[literal.atom.name][rule.statement.head.name])
                 then
                    return nil
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local changed = true
    while changed do
        changed = false
        for _, rule in ipairs(rules) do
            if rule.statement.head then
                for _, literal in ipairs(rule.statement.body) do
                    if literal.kind ~= "comparison" then
                        local required =
                            levels[literal.atom.name] + (literal.kind == "negative" and 1 or 0)
                        if levels[rule.statement.head.name] < required then
                            levels[rule.statement.head.name] = required
                            changed = true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return levels, recursive
end
function Database:levels()
    local arities = {}
    for name, predicate in pairs(self.predicates) do
        arities[name] = predicate.arity
    end
    return strata(arities, self.rules)
end
local function match(atom, values, assignment)
    local result = copy(assignment or {})
    for i, term in ipairs(atom.terms) do
        if term.kind == "constant" and term.value ~= values[i] then
            return nil
        end
        if term.kind == "variable" then
            if result[term.name] ~= nil and result[term.name] ~= values[i] then
                return nil
            end
            result[term.name] = values[i]
        end
    end
    return result
end
local function evaluate(expression, assignment)
    if expression.kind == "term" then
        return expression.term.kind == "constant" and expression.term.value or
            assignment[expression.term.name]
    end
    if expression.kind == "group" then
        return evaluate(expression.left, assignment)
    end
    local a, b = evaluate(expression.left, assignment), evaluate(expression.right, assignment)
    if type(a) ~= "number" or type(b) ~= "number" then
        return nil
    end
    local operator = expression.operator
    if operator == "+" then
        return a + b
    elseif operator == "-" then
        return a - b
    elseif operator == "*" then
        return a * b
    end
    if b == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local quotient = a // b
    return operator == "mod" and a - b * quotient or quotient
end
local function comparison(literal, assignment)
    local a, b = evaluate(literal.left, assignment), evaluate(literal.right, assignment)
    if a == nil or b == nil then
        return false
    end
    local operator = literal.operator
    if operator == "=" then
        return a == b
    elseif operator == "!=" then
        return a ~= b
    end
    if type(a) ~= "number" or type(b) ~= "number" then
        return false
    end
    if operator == "<" then
        return a < b
    elseif operator == "<=" then
        return a <= b
    elseif operator == ">" then
        return a > b
    else
        return a >= b
    end
end
local function solutions(body, model, before)
    local positives = {}
    for _, literal in ipairs(body) do
        if literal.kind == "positive" then
            positives[#positives + 1] = literal
        end
    end
    local function accepts_binding(binding)
        for _, literal in ipairs(body) do
            if literal.kind ~= "positive" then
                local ready = true
                for _, term in ipairs(literal_terms(literal)) do
                    if term.kind == "variable" and binding[term.name] == nil then
                        ready = false
                        break
                    end
                end
                if ready then
                    if literal.kind == "comparison" and not comparison(literal, binding) then
                        return false
                    end
                    if literal.kind == "negative" then
                        for _, tuple in pairs(model[literal.atom.name]) do
                            if match(literal.atom, tuple.values, binding) then
                                return false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    local result, finished = {}, {}
    local function binding_key(binding)
        local values = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(keys(binding)) do
            values[#values + 1] = binding[name]
        end
        return tuple_key(values)
    end
    local function visit(binding, remaining)
        if not accepts_binding(binding) then
            return
        end
        if #remaining == 0 then
            local key = binding_key(binding)
            if not finished[key] then
                finished[key] = true
                result[#result + 1] = binding
            end
            return
        end
        local selected, candidates
        for i, literal in ipairs(remaining) do
            local matches, seen = {}, {}
            for _, tuple in pairs(model[literal.atom.name]) do
                if not before or tuple.round < before then
                    local matched = match(literal.atom, tuple.values, binding)
                    if matched and accepts_binding(matched) then
                        local key = binding_key(matched)
                        if not seen[key] then
                            seen[key] = true
                            matches[#matches + 1] = matched
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if #matches == 0 then
                return
            end
            if not candidates or #matches < #candidates then
                selected, candidates = i, matches
            end
        end
        local next_remaining = {}
        for i, literal in ipairs(remaining) do
            if i ~= selected then
                next_remaining[#next_remaining + 1] = literal
            end
        end
        for _, matched in ipairs(candidates) do
            visit(matched, next_remaining)
        end
    end
    visit({}, positives)
    return result
end
local function atom_values(atom, assignment)
    local result = {}
    for _, term in ipairs(atom.terms) do
        result[#result + 1] = term.kind == "constant" and term.value or assignment[term.name]
    end
    return result
end
function Database:model()
    local levels = self:levels()
    local result = {tuples = {}, levels = levels, rounds = {}, added = {}}
    local maximum = -1
    for name, predicate in pairs(self.predicates) do
        result.tuples[name] = {}
        for key, values in pairs(predicate.facts) do
            result.tuples[name][key] = {values = values, round = 0, rule = 0}
        end
        maximum = math.max(maximum, levels[name])
    end
    local serial = 0
    for level = 0, maximum do
        result.rounds[level], result.added[level] = 0, 0
        while true do
            local pending, count = {}, 0
            for _, rule in ipairs(self.rules) do
                local head = rule.statement.head
                if head and levels[head.name] == level then
                    pending[head.name] = pending[head.name] or {}
                    for _, assignment in ipairs(solutions(rule.statement.body, result.tuples)) do
                        local values = atom_values(head, assignment)
                        local key = tuple_key(values)
                        if not result.tuples[head.name][key] and not pending[head.name][key] then
                            pending[head.name][key] = {values = values, rule = rule.number}
                            count = count + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if count == 0 then
                break
            end
            serial = serial + 1
            result.rounds[level] = result.rounds[level] + 1
            result.added[level] = result.added[level] + count
            for name, set in pairs(pending) do
                for key, tuple in pairs(set) do
                    tuple.round = serial
                    result.tuples[name][key] = tuple
                end
            end
        end
    end
    result.maximum = maximum
    return result
end
local function answer_rows(statement, model)
    local names = variables(all_terms({body = statement.body}))
    local rows = {}
    for _, assignment in ipairs(solutions(statement.body, model.tuples)) do
        local row = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(names) do
            row[#row + 1] = assignment[name]
        end
        rows[#rows + 1] = row
    end
    table.sort(
        rows,
        function(a, b)
            return compare_tuple(a, b) < 0
        end
    )
    return names, rows
end
local function answer_text(names, row)
    local parts = {}
    for i, name in ipairs(names) do
        parts[#parts + 1] = name .. " = " .. notation(row[i])
    end
    return table.concat(parts, ", ")
end
local function tuple_atom(name, values)
    local atom = {name = name, terms = {}}
    for _, value in ipairs(values) do
        atom.terms[#atom.terms + 1] = {kind = "constant", value = value}
    end
    return atom
end
function Database:proof(name, target, depth, model)
    local prefix = string.rep(" ", depth * 2) .. atom_text(tuple_atom(name, target.values))
    if target.round == 0 then
        return {prefix .. " [fact]"}
    end
    for _, rule in ipairs(self.rules) do
        local statement = rule.statement
        if statement.head and statement.head.name == name then
            local candidates = {}
            for _, binding in ipairs(solutions(statement.body, model.tuples, target.round)) do
                if compare_tuple(atom_values(statement.head, binding), target.values) == 0 then
                    candidates[#candidates + 1] = binding
                end
            end
            if #candidates > 0 then
                local names = variables(all_terms(statement))
                table.sort(
                    candidates,
                    function(a, b)
                        for _, variable in ipairs(names) do
                            local order = compare_value(a[variable], b[variable])
                            if order ~= 0 then
                                return order < 0
                            end
                        end
                        return false
                    end
                )
                local binding = candidates[1]
                local lines = {string.format("%s [rule %d]", prefix, rule.number)}
                for _, literal in ipairs(statement.body) do
                    if literal.kind == "positive" then
                        for _, tuple in ipairs(ordered_tuples(model.tuples[literal.atom.name])) do
                            if
                                tuple.round < target.round and
                                    match(literal.atom, tuple.values, binding)
                             then
                                for _, text in ipairs(
                                    self:proof(literal.atom.name, tuple, depth + 1, model)
                                ) do
                                    lines[#lines + 1] = text
                                end
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        lines[#lines + 1] =
                            string.rep(" ", (depth + 1) * 2) .. literal_text(literal, binding)
                    end
                end
                return lines
            end
        end
    end
end
local function plural(count, singular)
    return count == 1 and singular or singular .. "s"
end
function Database:execute(statement, line)
    local out = {}
    local function emit(format, ...)
        out[#out + 1] = string.format(format, ...)
    end
    local kind = statement.kind
    if kind == "fact" or kind == "rule" or kind == "constraint" then
        local arities = self:check_predicates(statement, true)
        safety(statement)
        if kind == "fact" then
            local head = statement.head
            local values = atom_values(head)
            local key = tuple_key(values)
            if self.predicates[head.name] and self.predicates[head.name].facts[key] then
                return out
            end
            self:save(line)
            self.predicates[head.name] = self.predicates[head.name] or {arity = #values, facts = {}}
            self.predicates[head.name].facts[key] = values
            return out
        end
        local text = rule_text(statement)
        for _, rule in ipairs(self.rules) do
            if rule_text(rule.statement) == text then
                fail("duplicate of rule %d", rule.number)
            end
        end
        local candidate = {}
        for i, rule in ipairs(self.rules) do
            candidate[i] = rule
        end
        candidate[#candidate + 1] = {number = self.next_number, statement = statement}
        if kind == "rule" and not strata(arities, candidate) then
            fail("negative cycle through %s", statement.head.name)
        end
        self:save(line)
        for name, arity in pairs(arities) do
            self.predicates[name] = self.predicates[name] or {arity = arity, facts = {}}
        end
        self.rules = candidate
        self.next_number = self.next_number + 1
        local terms = all_terms(statement)
        for _, name in ipairs(variables(terms)) do
            local count = 0
            for _, term in ipairs(terms) do
                if term.kind == "variable" and term.name == name then
                    count = count + 1
                end
            end
            if count == 1 then
                emit("WARNING line %d: singleton variable %s", line, name)
            end
        end
        return out
    end
    if kind == "undo" then
        if #self.history == 0 then
            fail("nothing to undo")
        end
        local previous = table.remove(self.history)
        self.predicates, self.rules = previous.predicates, previous.rules
        emit("undid line %d", previous.line)
        return out
    elseif kind == "forget" then
        local index
        for i, rule in ipairs(self.rules) do
            if rule.number == statement.number then
                index = i
                break
            end
        end
        if not index then
            fail("no rule %d", statement.number)
        end
        self:save(line)
        table.remove(self.rules, index)
        return out
    elseif kind == "listing" then
        if statement.name and not self.predicates[statement.name] then
            fail("unknown predicate %s", statement.name)
        end
        for _, rule in ipairs(self.rules) do
            if
                not statement.name or
                    rule.statement.head and rule.statement.head.name == statement.name
             then
                emit("%d: %s", rule.number, rule_text(rule.statement))
            end
        end
        if #out == 0 then
            emit("no rules")
        end
        return out
    elseif kind == "strata" then
        local levels, recursive = self:levels()
        local maximum = -1
        for _, level in pairs(levels) do
            maximum = math.max(maximum, level)
        end
        if maximum < 0 then
            emit("no predicates")
        end
        for level = 0, maximum do
            local names = {}
            for _, name in ipairs(keys(self.predicates)) do
                if levels[name] == level then
                    names[#names + 1] = name .. (recursive[name] and "*" or "")
                end
            end
            emit("stratum %d: %s", level, table.concat(names, ", "))
        end
        return out
    end
    if kind == "query" or kind == "retract" or kind == "why" then
        self:check_predicates(statement, false)
        if kind == "query" then
            safety(statement)
        end
    end
    if kind == "retract" then
        local predicate = self.predicates[statement.head.name]
        local removed = {}
        for key, values in pairs(predicate.facts) do
            if match(statement.head, values) then
                removed[#removed + 1] = key
            end
        end
        if #removed == 0 then
            fail("no matching facts")
        end
        self:save(line)
        for _, key in ipairs(removed) do
            predicate.facts[key] = nil
        end
        emit("%d %s retracted", #removed, plural(#removed, "fact"))
        return out
    end
    if kind == "why" then
        for _, term in ipairs(statement.head.terms) do
            if term.kind ~= "constant" then
                fail("why needs a ground atom")
            end
        end
    end
    if kind == "dump" and not self.predicates[statement.name] then
        fail("unknown predicate %s", statement.name)
    end
    local model = self:model()
    if kind == "query" then
        local names, answers = answer_rows(statement, model)
        if statement.aggregate == "count" then
            emit("%d", #answers)
        elseif statement.aggregate == "sum" then
            local column
            for i, name in ipairs(names) do
                if name == statement.variable then
                    column = i
                end
            end
            local total = 0
            for _, row in ipairs(answers) do
                if type(row[column]) ~= "number" then
                    fail("non-integer value in sum")
                end
                total = total + row[column]
            end
            emit("%d", total)
        elseif statement.aggregate == "min" or statement.aggregate == "max" then
            if #answers == 0 then
                emit("no answers")
            else
                local column
                for i, name in ipairs(names) do
                    if name == statement.variable then
                        column = i
                    end
                end
                local selected = answers[1][column]
                for _, row in ipairs(answers) do
                    local order = compare_value(row[column], selected)
                    if
                        statement.aggregate == "min" and order < 0 or
                            statement.aggregate == "max" and order > 0
                     then
                        selected = row[column]
                    end
                end
                emit("%s", notation(selected))
            end
        elseif #names == 0 then
            emit(#answers > 0 and "true." or "false.")
        else
            for _, row in ipairs(answers) do
                emit("%s", answer_text(names, row))
            end
            emit("%d %s", #answers, plural(#answers, "answer"))
        end
    elseif kind == "dump" then
        local rows = ordered_tuples(model.tuples[statement.name])
        for _, tuple in ipairs(rows) do
            emit("%s.", atom_text(tuple_atom(statement.name, tuple.values)))
        end
        emit("%d %s", #rows, plural(#rows, "tuple"))
    elseif kind == "why" then
        local tuple = model.tuples[statement.head.name][tuple_key(atom_values(statement.head))]
        if not tuple then
            emit("false.")
        else
            out = self:proof(statement.head.name, tuple, 0, model)
        end
    elseif kind == "check" then
        local count = 0
        for _, rule in ipairs(self.rules) do
            if not rule.statement.head then
                count = count + 1
                local names, answers = answer_rows(rule.statement, model)
                if #answers == 0 then
                    emit("constraint %d: ok", rule.number)
                else
                    emit(
                        "constraint %d: %d %s",
                        rule.number,
                        #answers,
                        plural(#answers, "violation")
                    )
                    if #names > 0 then
                        for _, row in ipairs(answers) do
                            emit("  %s", answer_text(names, row))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if count == 0 then
            emit("no constraints")
        end
    elseif kind == "predicates" then
        if next(self.predicates) == nil then
            emit("no predicates")
        end
        for _, name in ipairs(keys(self.predicates)) do
            local count = 0
            for _, rule in ipairs(self.rules) do
                if rule.statement.head and rule.statement.head.name == name then
                    count = count + 1
                end
            end
            local predicate = self.predicates[name]
            local facts, tuples = 0, 0
            for _ in pairs(predicate.facts) do
                facts = facts + 1
            end
            for _ in pairs(model.tuples[name]) do
                tuples = tuples + 1
            end
            emit(
                "%s/%d: facts %d, rules %d, tuples %d",
                name,
                predicate.arity,
                facts,
                count,
                tuples
            )
        end
    elseif kind == "stats" then
        local facts, rules, constraints, tuples = 0, 0, 0, 0
        for name, predicate in pairs(self.predicates) do
            for _ in pairs(predicate.facts) do
                facts = facts + 1
            end
            for _ in pairs(model.tuples[name]) do
                tuples = tuples + 1
            end
        end
        for _, rule in ipairs(self.rules) do
            if rule.statement.head then
                rules = rules + 1
            else
                constraints = constraints + 1
            end
        end
        emit("facts %d, rules %d, constraints %d, tuples %d", facts, rules, constraints, tuples)
        for level = 0, model.maximum do
            emit("stratum %d: rounds %d, new %d", level, model.rounds[level], model.added[level])
        end
        for _, rule in ipairs(self.rules) do
            if rule.statement.head then
                local count = 0
                for _, set in pairs(model.tuples) do
                    for _, tuple in pairs(set) do
                        if tuple.round > 0 and tuple.rule == rule.number then
                            count = count + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
                emit("rule %d: new %d", rule.number, count)
            end
        end
    end
    return out
end
local database = Database.new()
local line_number = 0
for line in io.lines() do
    line_number = line_number + 1
    local halt = false
    local ok, result =
        pcall(
        function()
            local tokens = lexical(line)
            if #tokens == 0 then
                return {}
            end
            local statement = setmetatable({tokens = tokens, position = 1}, Parser):statement()
            if statement.kind == "halt" then
                halt = true
                return {}
            end
            return database:execute(statement, line_number)
        end
    )
    if not ok then
        if type(result) ~= "table" or not result.reason then
            error(result, 0)
        end
        io.write(string.format("ERROR line %d: %s\n", line_number, result.reason))
    else
        for _, text in ipairs(result) do
            io.write(text, "\n")
        end
    end
    if halt then
        break
    end
end
